Title: Register with valid data
Steps: Enter all values and click Register
Expected Result: Registration succeeds and a success message is displayed
Actual Result: Successfully registered, you can log in now.

Title: Register with existing username
Steps: Submit the same registration data again
Expected Result: Registration is rejected with a clear message that the username already exists
Actual Result: An error occurred during registration. Please try again.

Title: Password and confirmation mismatch
Steps: Enter the values and click Register
Expected Result: Registration is rejected and a password mismatch message is displayed

Title: All fields empty
Steps: Leave all fields empty and click Register
Expected Result: Registration is rejected and required-field validation is displayed

Title: Confirmation password empty
Steps: Enter username and password; leave confirmation empty; click Register
Expected Result: Registration is rejected and required-field validation is displayed

Title: Invalid username format
Steps: Enter the values and click Register
Expected Result: Registration is rejected with a username validation message
Actual Result: Invalid username. Usernames can only contain lowercase letters, numbers, and single hyphens, must be between 3 and 39 characters, and cannot start or end with a hyphen.

Title: Username shorter than 3 characters
Steps: Enter the values and click Register
Expected Result: Registration is rejected with a minimum-length message
Actual Result: Username must be at least 3 characters long.
